pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft piano intro, quiet breathing atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
I open both arms
to the wide and quiet sky
the world feels closer
than it did before

I stand in the middle
of a noisy silent street
my body still shaking
but I’m still here

[Chorus]
I rise again
step by step into the day
a quiet fire inside my chest
begins to glow

I rise again
standing where the light returns
all the broken nights behind me
start to breathe

[Verse 2]
Yesterday’s sorrow
moves slowly in my lungs
like a wind that stayed
after the storm

The mirror shows someone
I almost recognize
a restless shadow
learning how to live

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, flowing and reflective)

[Bridge]
Fear walks beside me
but it doesn’t lead the way
the street ahead is calm
and strangely warm

In many languages
the same quiet voice appears
I woke again
I woke again

[Chorus]
I rise again
now the sky feels open wide
the quiet flame inside my chest
moves like the wind

I rise again
standing in the morning air
every silent step I take
feels like home

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, lingering emotional tone)

I rise again
the world slowly turns to me
and somewhere in the quiet light
I remain
